open_points.subject: A17
open_points.text:
The two addresses have different ports, so that the two
   surfaces never share an endpoint, and Registry opens each listener for
   itself alone, never with an option that lets another socket bind the
   same endpoint.
open_points.question: What must a Required tests item show to prove that each opened listener is exclusive and cannot be shared by another socket, in addition to proving that the configured ports differ?
options: After Registry binds a listener, an attempted second bind to that endpoint is refused.
A test inspects the listener configuration and proves that every endpoint-sharing option is disabled.
Only the different-port configuration check is tested; listener exclusivity is not tested.
open_points.default_guess: Test behavior by attempting a second bind to each opened endpoint and requiring it to fail.

witness.initial: Registry has a complete valid configuration whose owner and service API addresses use different ports, and neither endpoint is occupied.
events: Registry starts and opens both listeners.
Another local process attempts to bind a socket to one of Registry's endpoints using the platform's available sharing or reuse options.
outcomes: The second bind is refused because Registry's listener owns the endpoint exclusively.
The second bind succeeds because the implementation only checked that Registry's two configured ports differ and did not establish exclusive ownership.
witness.observer: The owner and callers reaching the shared endpoint.

open_points.subject: A21
open_points.text:
A17's change of the same day — a variable that names no
item is not read and does not stop the start — and its second, the
listeners' addresses named by the configuration as the deployment's (R0-19),
were reviewed under authentication_credential_abuse and secrets: no outcome
changed
open_points.question: After A17 newly added imported port bounds, the different-port refusal, and exclusive listener binding, which A21 security-review categories are reopened, and what is each category's resulting outcome?
options: Reperform every A21 category that references A17 and record the review of all newly added port and listener-binding rules.
Declare that the quoted 2026-11-11 review also covered the later A17 changes even though it identifies only the earlier two changes.
Remove A17 from the affected categories so its later changes do not reopen A21.
open_points.default_guess: Reperform authentication_credential_abuse and secrets, the categories that currently reference A17, explicitly reviewing the new port and exclusive-binding rules and recording their outcomes.
